iteration_0.issue: Evaluation window mismatch with task (predictions should be evaluated over days 30–39, but RMSE is computed over whatever overlap exists with train_data.csv)
iteration_0.impact: Misleading accuracy assessment; RMSE of ~0.31 likely reflects in-sample training window (days 0–29) rather than the holdout forecast window (days 30–39).
iteration_0.solution: Store observed adoption by explicit day index; evaluate RMSE/TimeTo50 strictly within [prediction_start_day, prediction_end_day] when observed data exists; otherwise skip or report that holdout observations are missing. Also export the forecast series for days 30–39.

iteration_0.issue: Early termination before completing the prediction window due to convergence check
iteration_0.impact: Forecast horizon may be cut short, producing incomplete or biased forecasts for days 30–39.
iteration_0.solution: Gate convergence termination so it cannot trigger before the prediction_end_day has been simulated.

iteration_0.issue: Behavioral validation metrics Rb and churn are NaN because observed counterparts are not computed from microdata
iteration_0.impact: Lack of validation on contagion strength and retention dynamics; reduces confidence in model mechanisms.
iteration_0.solution: Compute observed Rb and churn directly from train_data.csv by differencing per-agent wearing_mask between consecutive days; then compare with simulated series over the overlapping window.

iteration_0.issue: New adopters are counted via first_adoption_day only
iteration_0.impact: Re-adoptions after dropouts are not counted as new adoptions; Rb and churn metrics are distorted.
iteration_0.solution: Return and aggregate adopted_today events from the adoption module (including scheduled activations and immediate adoptions) rather than relying on first_adoption_day.

iteration_0.issue: Observed series stored as an unlabeled list loses explicit day indices
iteration_0.impact: Fragile alignment between observed and simulated days; breaks if the observed days do not start at 0 or are not contiguous.
iteration_0.solution: Store observed adoption as a dict day->rate to align precisely by day; use these day keys for evaluation.
